description: maxWeight = floor(1e6 / budget). The protocol bound is budget x maxWeight <= 1e6. Two implementations derive this — apps/hub/src/helpers/gegConfig.ts advertises it in the election config the committee verifies against, apps/sequencer/src/helpers/teCommittee.ts clamps with it before minting. A drift means the sequencer attests weights the committee rejects as INVALID_ATTESTATION, so both assert against this table rather than against each other.
